column1: # .world level file: loader, chunk drawing, texture cells, automap grid. See docs/formats/world.md

column3: (world) after load: lump_load of "<name>.lmp" for every flag-0x800 chunk, worldtex_loadAlwaysPages, then sizes and allocates the texture segment cache (world +0x60, +0x7c); caller game_loadLevel
(world, column, row) -> size of texture cell row*100+column in 128 KB blocks, 0 when outside the id range
(world): world_setPieceCollision(i, 0) for every moving piece whose claimed bit (+6 bit 0) is clear; caller game_loadLevel after the objects exist
(world, piece): clears the claimed bit that world_findMovingPiece sets
(world, piece, minOut, maxOut): union of the piece's chunk bounds with the 48-unit padding removed
(world, piece, on): sets or clears chunk flag 0x100 on the piece's chunks
(name): reads the 0x800-byte GOB directory, then every lump in file order, running lump_fixup on each; caller game_loadLevel with "<level>.gob"

(world, chunk, clip): dispatches on chunk flags 0x80/0x800/0x4000/0x8000, otherwise builds the per-chunk VIF header (matrix, lights, STROW translation) and a DMA ref to the stored packet; returns early when chunk +0x34 is 0
flag 0x80: allocates or refreshes the 32x32 simulation block and draws it with microprogram entry 0x36
flag 0x800: resolves "<lump>.lmp" / "<model>.vif|.tex|.anm" on first use, claims a scenery animation slot, draws the model
flag 0x4000: runs the particle emitter type chunk+4 at translation * 0.25
flag 0x8000: flicker modes 0-4 from the light record, writes one of 16 light slots and links it; optional glow sprite
(chunk) -> slot 0-15; least recently used slot is taken over, owner chunk's +4 cleared
(world, view): same tree walk as world_draw but only requests textures; caller cut_evalCamera
recycles the least recently used water simulation block
(world, waterRecord): starts the 32x32 heights from the four neighbour chunks named in the record
(tex) level start: water constants and texture; with level option bit 8 fills every water chunk's 128-byte mask with 0xff
reads each listed texture cell of "<level>.tex" whole and relocates its textures
(cell or -1): keeps the 3x3 texture cells around g_cameraFocus loaded, 128 KB per call; cell = floor(pos / world+0x68) + 50
(world, texHeader, blockMap, base): as tex_relocate, but offsets are from the start of the cell and go through the 128 KB block map
(texHeader, cell): appends to a 64-entry ring of textures wanted this frame
(world): copies the grid at world +0x80 (s16 x0, y0, w, h, then w*h cells) into g_automapGrid when world +0x6c and +0x80 are set and +0x70 is 0
(out): explored nibbles of every second cell in both directions, two per byte; caller save_writeLevelState
(in): inverse of automap_packExplored, averaging neighbours for the cells in between; caller level_loadScriptAndObjects
one byte per texture cell id: slot index into g_texCellBlob, -1 when not loaded
pointer to the loaded cell data per slot; slots 0-8 streamed, 9 and up always-loaded pages
cell id held by each of the 9 streaming slots, -1 when empty
{cell id, pointer} pairs, count at 0x7d35a0
up to 16 particle emitter records copied from flag-0x4000 chunks, 0x98 bytes each (0x48 from the file, generator state after); count g_worldEmitterTypeCount
light node of the first of 16 records used by flag-0x8000 chunks; records are 0x44 bytes from 0x7d3f68: frame stamp, owner chunk, light node
64 animation states of 0x30 bytes shared by model chunks using the same .anm
216 x 216 s16 cells; bits 12-15 of a cell are the explored level
float; cell column = origin + x / 120
base name used to open "<name>.tex" in world_fixup and worldtex_loadAlwaysPages
min xyz, max xyz: union of all chunk bounds, built by game_loadLevel

column1: # ---- level texture streaming and block decoding (docs/formats/level-texture.md) ----

column3: thread entry created by texcache_init: takes headers off the request ring, decodes their block streams (canonical Huffman, 269 symbols) into the scratchpad, permutes each block into an 8x8 PSMCT32 block and builds the upload chain stored at header +0x14; see docs/formats/level-texture.md
fills g_texBlockPermutation: decoded texel x+16y for every byte of the 8x8 32-bit block (the GS 8-bit-in-32-bit swizzle); caller texcache_init
(tex, &writePtr, &prevLink, &head, last): moves 4 KB of upload chain from the scratchpad into a page of the chain pool and links it; caller worldtex_workerThread
stops the worker thread, frees the segment cache, resets slots and tables; caller game_clearLevel
clears the upload request ring and the worker's state; callers inventory_pollResources and level code
(tex): preparation of a flag-0x0001 header before its chain is built; no texture on the disc has the flag, body not read
(cell): appends to g_texAlwaysPages; NO CALLER, so no cell is ever always-loaded
count at 0x7d35a0 = 0; caller 0x1826c8
5 signed bytes -1, -16, -17, -15, -2: texel offsets of symbols 0x100-0x104 of the level texture block code
256 bytes built by worldtex_buildBlockPermutation
64 x {header, cell id} wanted by world_drawChunk; head 0x7d3540, tail 0x7d3544
base of the 4 KB pages holding built upload chains
0x500 x {owner header, next page}; a chain is freed by tex_evict or by the worker after 3 unused frames
9 x 0x80 bytes: for each streaming slot, piece k of the cell -> block of the segment cache, 0xff past the end
one byte per 128 KB block of the segment cache (world +0x7c): 1 = in use
worldtex_stream state 0 choose / 1 read pieces / 2 evict / 3 start
header the worker is building a chain for, 0 when idle
slot being filled; 0x7d3549 piece-done flag, 0x7d354a (s16) cell id being read
slots to evict before the read, count at 0x41c1ac
128 KB pieces of the current cell read so far
1 while a cell is wanted but not loaded; 0x41c1b4 = cell file is open
cleared by world_drawChunk when a chunk's texture cell or chain is missing
the lump found as dome.lmp by game_loadLevel (0x1e5d48); game_drawBackdrop draws its .vif models at the camera with scale 1e6
